# netcup_scp_user_ssh_key (Resource)

Manages an SSH key for a netcup SCP user account. SSH keys cannot be updated in place; changing `name` or `key` replaces the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_scp_user_ssh_key" "example" {
  user_id = 12345
  name    = "my-key"
  key     = "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIDIhz2GK/XCu1krZ6B/jWhdd1Rzie/OXtmYPTQG5jmy7 example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String, Sensitive) The public SSH key.
- `name` (String) Name of the SSH key.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user account that owns the SSH key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp of the SSH key.
- `id` (Number) ID of the SSH key assigned by the API.
